name: 50 50 Sweet & Salty
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined (Palmolein & Palm) Oil, Sugar (18%), Raising Agents [503(ii), 500(ii) & 341 (i)], Iodised Salt (0.8%), Invert Sugar Syrup, Yeast, Acidity Regulators (270 & 330), Emulsifier (472e), Nature Identical And Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances, Dough Conditioner (223) And Improvers [1101 (i), 1101 (ii), 1100(i) & Xylanase].
